title: BrowserStatus

port.description: The loopback port the extension dials, which the port file names.

oneOf.description: The listener is bound on loopback.

reason.description: port-in-use: every port of the range was taken (the error the Browser card shows); bind-failed: binding failed otherwise.

message.description: What happened, as a sentence for a person.

oneOf.description: The listener is not bound, so no Chrome can reach this environment until it starts again.

listener.description: The extension listener: its port, or why it has none.

path.description: The folder Chrome loads unpacked: extension/current in the environment's data directory.

problem.description: Why the folder does not hold the shipped extension (none is carried, a copy or a rename failed), as a sentence; null when it does.

folder.description: The extension's folder: where it is, and what is wrong with it.

shippedVersion.description: The version of the extension the environment ships, its manifest's version name, which is the harness version; null when it carries none.

unpairedConnected.description: Whether an extension that holds no credential has announced itself and keeps its socket open.

allowRuns.description: browser.headless.allowRuns: whether runs on this environment may drive its headless browser.

oneOf.description: An operator's browser beside the environment, reached at its CDP address.

executable.description: The Chromium or Chrome the environment launches: browser.headless.executable, else the first found in the platform's usual locations and PATH.

oneOf.description: A Chromium or Chrome the environment launches itself under new headless, over a pipe, with a throwaway profile.

source.description: Where the headless browser comes from.

oneOf.description: The environment has a headless browser, from this source.

reason.description: Why it has none, as a sentence for a person.

oneOf.description: The environment has no headless browser.

availability.description: Whether the environment has a headless browser, and its source or why not.

liveContexts.description: How many sessions hold a browser context in it now, one each.

headless.description: The headless browser's part of browser.status: its permission, its availability or why not, its source and its live contexts.

description: browser.status: the listener's port or error, the folder's path, the shipped version and whether an unpaired extension is connected; and the headless browser's permission, availability or reason, source and live contexts.
